name: ai-sentinel-api
description: AI Sentinel NIDS backend: FastAPI + scikit-learn RandomForest + IsolationForest + WebSockets

scripts.train: bash -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; else PY=python3; fi; $PY ml/train.py'
scripts.generate:dataset: bash -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; else PY=python3; fi; $PY ml/generate_dataset.py'
scripts.evaluate: bash -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; else PY=python3; fi; $PY ml/evaluate.py'
scripts.generate:pcaps: bash -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; else PY=python3; fi; $PY tools/generate_samples.py'
